data.summary: Beispielstrom Mittelhessen GmbH is raising prices in the "Region Basis" electricity tariff from 1 January 2027, increasing the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) from €86.00 to €92.00; the energy price rises from 32.10 ct/kWh to 34.45 ct/kWh and the base price from €13.20 to €14.10 per month.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is increasing its prices because of higher network and procurement costs. This affects your monthly advance payment, which will rise to €92.00. Because this is a price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract without notice and without any cost, effective on the date the increase takes effect, if you do not agree with it — the app will show you the deadline by which your cancellation must arrive in writing (Textform). If you do nothing, the new prices simply apply from the date given. No action is strictly required otherwise.
